overview: Retrospective development of a booking-time prediction model for failed same-day discharge after elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy, using 2019 to 2023 records for development and 2024 to 2025 records for temporal validation.
population: All adults booked for elective day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomy from January 2019 to December 2025 (about 3,690 procedures); first procedure per patient.
exposure: Pre-specified booking-time predictors: age, anaesthetic risk class, body mass index, previous nausea with anaesthesia, diabetes, living alone, travel distance and planned list position (first half or second half, and start after 13:00).
procedures: The analyst extracts booking, theatre, medication and discharge data under approval DAC-2026-51. Nausea needing treatment is taken from rescue antiemetic doses in the medication record, checked first against 100 randomly sampled charts. Time of first walking, available from mid-2021, is used only in a sensitivity analysis. Surgeon is recorded for clustering.

outcomes.name: Failed same-day discharge
outcomes.measure: Overnight stay after a day-case booking, from the discharge record
outcomes.why: The event the booking model predicts.

outcomes.name: Model calibration on validation data
outcomes.measure: Calibration intercept and slope in 2024 to 2025
outcomes.why: A booking tool must be calibrated to be usable.

outcomes.name: Discrimination on validation data
outcomes.why: Shows the fall from development seen elsewhere (claim c4).

outcomes.name: Unplanned readmission within 7 days after same-day discharge
outcomes.why: Guards against a model that sends home patients who should stay.

feasibility: About 20 analyst days: 8 for extraction and cleaning, 2 for the proxy check support, 7 for modelling and validation, 3 for reporting.
biasMitigation: Temporal validation on a later period
List position modelled explicitly and interpreted as partly chosen by risk

biasFlags.label: Changes in practice over 2019 to 2025
biasFlags.note: Temporal validation shows the effect of drift.

biasFlags.label: List position chosen by risk
biasFlags.note: Predictions by list position are not causal effects.

flags: Eight pre-specified predictors; no selection by significance
parsimony.simplestPath: One penalised model, one temporal validation, one calibration plot.

theoreticalFramework: None; TRIPOD for development and validation reporting.
summary: Retrospective development and temporal validation protocol aligned with the accepted second decision.
